title: MiniMax H3 Structured Prompt Schema
description: Schema for validating MiniMax H3 structured prompts produced by this skill. H3 is the only model in the video catalogue whose vendor documents a structured multi-section prompt format. NOTE: these sections are labelled prose blocks inside a single newline-delimited text string, not JSON keys on the API. This schema describes the composition surface; the sections are serialised in fixed order into the one `text` item the API accepts.

mode.description: Selects which section set applies. reference_to_video uses all six sections with `detailed_description` as the main block; all other modes omit subject_definitions and retention_analysis and use `integrated_multimodal_description` instead. image_to_video, last_frame and first_and_last_frame are mutually exclusive with reference_to_video — first_frame/last_frame roles cannot be combined with any reference_* role.

spec.description: The six documented prose sections, in fixed order. Authoritative for the API call. NOTHING here is auto-synced from the prose rendering — if you revise one section, revise all.

subject_definitions.description: Section 1. Binds each <Subject N> token to its source assets. Required in reference_to_video, omitted otherwise.

token.description: Literal token form: angle brackets, capitalised type word, space, arabic numeral. e.g. "<Subject 1>"

definition.description: Prose binding the subject to its sources, e.g. "<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>, with long dark hair, a blue cardigan, and a thin silver necklace." A subject may draw different attributes from different sources.

sources.description: The reference tokens this subject draws from.

visual_retention.description: Fixed vocabulary. attribute_transfer specifically means characteristics moved to a DIFFERENT identifiable target subject — not 'loosely inspired by'. For a reference guiding only camera behaviour, weak_reference on a <Video N> is more accurate.

audio_retention.description: Fixed vocabulary, used when the subject draws voice timbre from an <Audio N>.

summary.description: Section 2. One or two sentences stating what the shot is.

retention_analysis.description: Section 3. What must be preserved from each reference and what may change. Required in reference_to_video, omitted otherwise.

detailed_description.description: Section 4, and the main prose block in reference_to_video mode. Carries action, camera, setting, light and dialogue. Recommended length 350-500 English words on generation tasks. Camera cues ([pan], [zoom], [static]) go inline directly after the description they apply to. Shot markers ([Shot 1]) and timestamps (At 00:04.000,) are also inline. Dialogue lives ONLY here, inside <d>[Language] … </d> with (S1)/(S2) speaker IDs.

integrated_multimodal_description.description: Section 4 alternative. The main prose block in text_to_video, image_to_video, last_frame and first_and_last_frame modes. Same content rules as detailed_description. Exactly one of these two fields must be present.

overall_soundscape.description: Section 5. Diegetic sound only — effects and ambience. Do NOT repeat dialogue lines here; they belong inside <d> in the main description, and duplicating them produces doubled audio.

non_diegetic_music.description: Section 6. Score, if any. Leave empty for unscored shots rather than inventing a bed.

settings.description: Suggested settings, kept strictly out of the prompt prose. resolution and duration are REQUIRED by the API with no defaults.

model.description: Sole enum value in the API.

resolution.description: Required, no default. 768P is the base model's native output (short side 768px). 2K is produced by a separate H3-Regenerate-2K pass, not by the base model.

ratio.description: Must be explicit and non-adaptive for text_to_video. Forced to adaptive for image_to_video. Optional for reference_to_video.

references.description: Asset budget for reference_to_video. Combined ceiling is 12 files across all categories.

images.description: Max 9. Each 256-5760px per side, aspect ratio between 2:5 and 5:2, max 30MB.

videos.description: Max 3. Each 2-15s, combined not exceeding 15s. Max 50MB each.

audio.description: Max 3, same duration rules as video. Max 15MB each. Audio CANNOT be the sole input — it must be paired with an image or video.

notes.description: Caveats, inference declarations, and routing recommendations — including recommending a different model where H3 is the wrong choice. Honesty lives here; do not bury limitations in prose.
